anchor.label: End of the page: the Join button leaves on a short timed fade, nothing on it follows your finger

messages.text:
The iPhone is yours now, for 15 minutes; the robot test of the menu-open fix waits until you finish.
| Page | Link on the iPhone |
|---|---|
| A: v11 (today's build) | http://lan:6431/ |
| B: rev 3 (timed fade, nothing follows your finger) | http://lan:6435/ |
- Scroll to the end of the page and open the menu slowly past 20 % and back; watch the Join button and the EN pill.
- The phone is cool (33 °C) and has no heat setting on; the links also sit on the Proposals page.
What you need to do: try A and B, then decide on the Join button change (PR-032) and reply here "done with the phone".

Thanks: the Join button change (PR-032 rev 3) is accepted and goes into the next build.
- The next robot iPhone test now checks the full next build, not v11 alone: v11 + the People title slide + the menu-open fix + this Join button change.
- It starts when you are done with the phone (your time ends 04:57Z at the latest).
- If it is no worse than today's best, that build becomes the new best and I update the best-builds list.
What you need to do: reply "done with the phone" here when you finish, or nothing and it ends by itself at 04:57Z.
